features.title: Search and disclose tools per agent
features.summary: Keep a bounded global tool surface per agent and progressively reveal ranked global tools through Native Tool Mode search.

configuration.constraints: cache-safe keeps one tool list for the whole Session (core tools, tool_search, tool_call) and returns schemas as text; progressive adds the matches to the tool list.

configuration.defaultValue: the native core tools (read, write, edit, apply_patch, bash, glob, grep, todo_write, skill, ask_user_question, job_*, subagent*, …)
configuration.constraints: Trimmed names; only * is a wildcard.
When the global tool set changes mid-Session, the next step gets one reminder naming only the added tools (with a one-sentence description) and the removed names; false sends nothing.

failureModes: Invalid query bounds fail without changing visibility.
Code Mode nested searches are denied.

verification.testName: ranks exact names first and uses deterministic name order for ties
returns schemas in the search result and keeps the declared tools identical across the Session
diffs names in order and renders only the change
keeps the declared tool list fixed in cache-safe mode when an always-visible tool appears mid-Session
keeps discovery isolated per agent and loads a matching global tool
restores prior disclosure from the durable request header and tracks late global MCP tools
rejects nested Code Mode search and unload removes only its own scope contributions
records an Effect span when a tool search runs
refuses blank search input with its validation message

verification.reason: Agent-scoped tool visibility has no browser surface; the scratch Host and AgentLoop journey plus Host tests exercise registration and disclosure behavior.

telemetry.testName: records an Effect span when a tool search runs

features.title: Tools per agent: enabled and pinned
features.summary: The thread's agent decides which tools reach it. tool-search declares the @dshfiles/tool-search/access contract (the dshfilesToolAccess Cordis service, provided by @dshfiles/agents): every tool is on by default, a disabled tool or group is never declared, searched, proxied or called, a pinned one is declared from the first request, and a per-thread override applies from the next request. tool_search_access shows the calling thread's agent and effective access.
features.currentSurface: host: agent tool tool_search_access; contract module @dshfiles/tool-search/access
failureModes: Without a provider every tool is on and nothing beyond alwaysVisible is pinned, as before.
A provider that throws while an agent attaches leaves that agent unattached and logs a warning naming the cause.
tool_search and tool_call are never disabled, whatever an entry says.

verification.testName: keeps a disabled tool out of the declarations, tool_search, tool_call and a direct call, and declares a pinned one
lets a tool entry beat its group, disables a tool that appears later in a disabled group, and enables a new group
switches a thread to an override from its next request and back again
hands the provider a subagent's parent Session and resolves it once
leaves every tool on without a provider, as before
lets a tool entry beat its group entry, field by field, and the group beat the default
disables a tool added later to a disabled group, and enables one from a group never configured

verification.reason: tool-search has no browser surface; the agents plugin owns the controls (its UI wave), and the AgentLoop integration tests drive declarations, tool_search, tool_call and direct calls through a real Host context.

telemetry.testName: switches a thread to an override from its next request and back again
